## Details

<a id="room_draw_step_cell"></a>
### [`room_draw_step_cell`](../../../../src/room/draw_helpers.asm#L9) `$485B`

*routine*

Called by draw_room after each map cell. Counts column_counter down; when it passes 0 it reloads 39 and adds 40 to row_ptr_top, row_ptr_bottom, colour_ptr_top and colour_ptr_bottom, so the next cell starts two screen rows lower (a map cell is a double-height character and the per-cell increments have already crossed one row). Preserves A, X, Y.

- **Called from:** [`draw_room`](draw_room.md#draw_room)
- **Reads:** [`column_counter`](../../memory-map.md#column_counter), [`row_ptr_top`](../../memory-map.md#row_ptr_top), [`row_ptr_bottom`](../../memory-map.md#row_ptr_bottom), [`colour_ptr_top`](../../memory-map.md#colour_ptr_top), [`colour_ptr_bottom`](../../memory-map.md#colour_ptr_bottom)
- **Writes:** [`column_counter`](../../memory-map.md#column_counter), [`row_ptr_top`](../../memory-map.md#row_ptr_top), [`row_ptr_bottom`](../../memory-map.md#row_ptr_bottom), [`colour_ptr_top`](../../memory-map.md#colour_ptr_top), [`colour_ptr_bottom`](../../memory-map.md#colour_ptr_bottom)
- **Refers to:** [`row_ptr_top`](../../memory-map.md#row_ptr_top), [`row_ptr_bottom`](../../memory-map.md#row_ptr_bottom), [`colour_ptr_top`](../../memory-map.md#colour_ptr_top), [`colour_ptr_bottom`](../../memory-map.md#colour_ptr_bottom)

<a id="build_double_height_font"></a>
### [`build_double_height_font`](../../../../src/room/draw_helpers.asm#L51) `$4892`

*routine*

Builds a double-height charset from an 8x8 font. Input: row_ptr_top = source (128 chars of 8 bytes), data_ptr = output for the top halves, row_ptr_bottom = output for the bottom halves, column_counter = number of chars - 1 ($7F). For each source char, rows 0-3 are written twice each to (data_ptr) and rows 4-7 twice each to (row_ptr_bottom), so char c of the output charset is the top half and char c+$80 the bottom half of source char c. cold_start calls it 4 times: room_charset_a -> charset_rooms_0_9, room_charset_b -> charset_rooms_10_19, room_charset_c -> charset_wizard, room_charset_d -> charset_wizard_flash (top halves at +0, bottom at +$400).

- **Called from:** [`cold_start`](../game/cold_start.md#cold_start)
- **Calls:** [`inc_data_ptr`](../text/pointer_helpers.md#inc_data_ptr), [`inc_row_ptr_top`](../text/pointer_helpers.md#inc_row_ptr_top), [`inc_row_ptr_bottom`](../text/pointer_helpers.md#inc_row_ptr_bottom)
- **Reads:** [`row_ptr_top`](../../memory-map.md#row_ptr_top), [`data_ptr`](../../memory-map.md#data_ptr), [`row_ptr_bottom`](../../memory-map.md#row_ptr_bottom), [`column_counter`](../../memory-map.md#column_counter)
- **Writes:** [`column_counter`](../../memory-map.md#column_counter)
